stable.title: DroidDeck 0.4.0
stable.summary:
> TL;DR for Mr. Sujano specifically
>
> And speaking about the coolest thing since sliced bread, next up here we're talking about DroidDeck.
>
> For those who are unaware, DroidDeck brings the SteamOS experience to Android on your Snapdragon powered handheld, and DroidDeck just got a brand new update. Now, they just released version 0.4.0, and taking a look at this update, it seems to be a pretty big one.
>
> It says here they've added GOG, Epic Games and Amazon Games integration, with cloud saves for GOG and Epic. On top of that here, they've implemented a fully featured SteamOS-style KDE Plasma desktop with a working "Return to Gaming Mode."
>
> Steam's own Steam Link touch controller, with community layouts that back up to Steam Cloud. Support for connecting up to four controllers for local co-op. Native support for the new Steam Controller. And the built-in controls can now pretend to be a Steam Deck, Steam Controller, Xbox 360, DualShock 4 or DualSense.
>
> If you're on a foldable, Steam and your games now resize when you fold, unfold or rotate, and there's an optional touch gamepad below the game when it's unfolded.
>
> They've also got per-game compatibility profiles, automatic redistributable and Windows component installs, their own custom DroidDeck-Proton, and streamlined non-Steam game imports with automatic artwork. And on the performance side, PRoot is up to 57% faster in some workloads, with lower idle CPU usage, and even more.
>
> You let me know your thoughts.

preview.title: fix: the Debugging tools hint points to Setup > Diagnostics
preview.summary: With Debugging tools off, droiddeckctl tells you to turn on Setup > Session > Debugging tools. Setup has no Session tab; the toggle is under Diagnostics.

recentPreviews.title: fix: the Debugging tools hint points to Setup > Diagnostics
recentPreviews.summary: With Debugging tools off, droiddeckctl tells you to turn on Setup > Session > Debugging tools. Setup has no Session tab; the toggle is under Diagnostics.

recentPreviews.title: Add experimental Quest 2 and Adreno 6xx display-driver support
recentPreviews.summary: The Test 2 APK was built from PR #669 (d3f3439) with these compatibility changes. The tester confirms that it now works on Quest. Specific game coverage has not been recorded.

recentPreviews.title: fix: the Android keyboard opens on the first tap after the system dismissed it
recentPreviews.summary: After the Android keyboard is closed with Back, the next tap on Android keyboard in the session menu does nothing; a second tap brings it up (#567 part 1, and I believe #258).

recentPreviews.title: Feat/reset all settings
recentPreviews.summary:
Adds a "Reset all settings" button in Setup > Diagnostics.
It resets all settings to default but keeps your games, logins and
downloads. There's also a checkbox to reset game profiles.
Translated into all app languages. Tested on my S24 Ultra, works fine.

recentPreviews.title: Add translations for 23 more languages and fill missing strings
recentPreviews.summary:
• 23 more app languages, all selectable in the language picker and in Android 13+'s per-app language settings (localesconfig.xml):
• Brazilian Portuguese and European Portuguese, plus Latin American Spanish as an overlay on Spanish.
• Indonesian, Malay, Czech, Danish, German, Italian, Hungarian, Dutch, Norwegian Bokmål, Polish, Romanian, Finnish, Swedish, Vietnamese, Turkish, Greek, Bulgarian, Ukr

recentPreviews.title: Add opt-in zRAM compression for the Steam client while a game runs
recentPreviews.summary: A "zRAM compression" toggle under Steam > Settings > Session, below "Keep downloads running". Off by default, kept once set, and disabled on devices without swap or with a kernel older than 5.4.

recentPreviews.title: fix: don't count a re-attached unchanged buffer as a new game frame
recentPreviews.summary: From the "Unstable frame limit" Discord thread. With a 30 FPS cap (from Steam's QAM or from the game itself), LSFG and Win-FG were fed ~50–60 "source frames" a second while the game made 30. The in-app HUD read "LSFG 2× 59 → 54" / "53 → 60" with MangoHud at 30, and camera motion felt floaty. It depended on the game: Super Meat Boy did 30 → 60, Divinity and Quake didn't.

recentPreviews.title: feat(): Rich Game details for GOG & Epic - Publisher, Developer, Release Date, HLTB & Metacritic
recentPreviews.summary: This PR brings in rich details for GOG & Epic games.

recentPreviews.title: Use preview-builds for the Discord channel name
recentPreviews.summary: Update the channel documentation and workflow comment to match the Discord rename from preview to preview-builds, preserving the existing webhook routing.

recentPreviews.title: Align Discord build names with the app
recentPreviews.summary: Use Preview and Test builds in Discord announcements and document safe channel renames while preserving the existing webhook secrets and message references.

tests.title: Keep visible external-display sessions running
tests.summary: Respect the session Activity’s display power when suspending or resuming, preventing handset screen-off from pausing visible DeX sessions (refs #586 and #741); Android 26/28/29/33 and visibility-transition regressions pass, with Samsung hardware validation pending.

tests.title: Fix Flatpak installs on older Android kernels
tests.summary: Recover missing statx mount IDs from verified, pinned file descriptors on older kernels so Flatpak installs can proceed, fixing #445; Linux regression tests and the ARM64 PRoot/APK build pass.

tests.title: Preserve native Linux and FEX compatibility choices
tests.summary: Preserve native Linux defaults and explicit Linux Runtime, FEX, and Proton choices instead of rewriting them to the global Proton tool, fixing #533.

tests.title: Fix microphone capture in DirectAudio games
tests.summary: Pass the session microphone setting to DirectAudio games and prevent game environment overrides from enabling capture when the microphone is disabled.

tests.title: fix: Windows components: .NET Core / Desktop runtimes install again
tests.summary: Installing .NET Desktop 3/6/7/8, .NET Core 3 or .NET 5 from Windows components failed with "the installer stopped (status 1)". This blocks MelonLoader/LemonLoader mods (Drova – Forsaken Kin, Stardew Valley) and Baldur's Gate 3.

tests.title: fix(quest): correct desktop and Steam display corruption across sessions
tests.summary: Quest 3 showed vertical corruption in Desktop, green artifacts in Steam's letterbox borders, and corruption carried across Desktop/Steam transitions. The compositor persists across sessions, while the existing workaround depends on the first session's HDR setup.

tests.title: Add VITURE glasses support, with SteamVR at 120 fps on them
tests.summary: Support for VITURE XR glasses. DroidDeck drives the glasses over USB (refresh rate, 3D, brightness, volume, sunblock), uses their IMU for head tracking, and shows games or SteamVR on them. Tested on a VITURE Pro XR with a RedMagic phone, playing Angry Birds VR: Isle of Pigs from the start screen into Sandy Beach level 1.

tests.title: fix(session): prevent overlapping startup and teardown
tests.summary: Users reported Steam appearing offline. Logs showed Session Replaced after successful sign-in, while downloads still worked. This PR prevents overlapping local sessions, one possible cause, but does not establish the cause of those reports.

tests.title: Fix direct-touch right-click and Steam Touch mode restoration
tests.summary: Addresses #628 by adding long-press right-click to Direct Touch (including Steam Touch’s direct mode) and restoring the saved touch mode when Steam Touch is disabled; all 10 focused tests pass, with device validation pending.

tests.title: Steam client download: resumes, retries, shows megabytes, and isn't paused out of sight
tests.summary: A user's first Steam setup never finished on an Honor Pad (Snapdragon 6 Gen 1, metered Wi-Fi with a 14 Mbit/s link). Their log stops at downloading Steam: binslinuxarm64linuxarm64 (2/17). The log was shared 31 s into the session, so nothing had failed yet. The way the download works explains why it never got further.

tests.title: feat: target Android API 36
tests.summary: Moves the app from targetSdk 28 to targetSdk 36 (compileSdk 34 → 36).

tests.title: perf: the session's background watchers share two loops and one D-Bus service process
tests.summary: Cuts the Steam session's own background processes from 13 to 7 with every watcher enabled, without changing what any of them does. It's part of getting the session under Android's 32-process "phantom process" limit. Together with #566 (web helper 8 → 4), an idle Steam session goes from ~41 processes to ~30 on the Thor.

tests.title: perf: Steam's web helper runs its GPU, audio and zygote work inside one process
tests.summary: Cuts Steam's web helper from 8 processes to 4 by running its GPU process, audio service and zygotes inside the browser process. This lowers the session's count against Android's child-process limit. On the Thor, under identical conditions, the whole session went from 41 to 37 processes; the web helper's memory went from ~1.4 GB to ~1.14 GB RSS.

tests.title: Accessibility tab: install and enable Orca in every Linux session
tests.summary: Adds an Accessibility tab to the launcher's front-end rail: an introduction to Orca (the GNOME screen reader), an install button, an open-settings button and a master switch that defaults on after install.

tests.title: Rumble: reliable controller motors, Deck haptics, optional Razer Kishi USB rumble; Kishi L4/R4 as Deck back grips
tests.summary: ﻿Fixes the rumble part of #219 / follow-up to #242. Reported in the DroidDeck Discord #bug-reports forum (Kishi V3 Pro on a Galaxy S26 Ultra), with logs there.

tests.title: Return to the launcher when a front-end game closes
tests.summary: When a game started from DroidDeck's Games tab (or from another launcher's link) closes, DroidDeck now ends the Steam session cleanly and takes you back to where you launched it, instead of leaving you in Big Picture.
